tw-walkable-decks.steer:
We’re close but we want to split the difference a bit in between what’s currently rendered and the spiritfayer style.

What’s emerging for me is an FTL style
Different ship design as a function of which of the game master faces is running the game. 

The first chapter of the game should be designing based on shamanic feel and emotional alchemy as made manifest through the game design ontology and the game design roles skill

Then as the pipeline is worked through the player can unlock a ship that has 2 decks the shaman deck and the challenger deck 

And then another and then another (regent and architect) 
Each reflecting the style and concern of that level of development as well as the complicity afforded and the emotional energy cost
